descriptions: In this study it is investigated whether quantity and quality feedback influences order picking performance.The data contains two datasets of separate experiments, one experiment was conducted at Rotterdam School of Management, Erasmus University. The other experiment was conducted at Northwestern Polytechnical University in Xi'an, China.
